title: Dynamic Free-Rider Detection in Cross-Silo Federated Learning via Simulated Attack Patterns
abstract: arXiv:2604.04611v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Federated learning (FL) enables multiple clients to collaboratively train a global model by aggregating local updates without sharing private data. In this work, we focus on cross-silo FL, where each client typically represents an independent organization. However, cross-silo FL can face the challenge of free-riders, clients who submit fake model parameters without performing actual training to obtain the global model without contributing. Chen et al. proposed a free-rider detection method based on the weight evolving frequency (WEF) of model parameters. This detection approach is practical because it requires neither a proxy dataset nor pre-training. Nevertheless, it struggles to detect ``dynamic'' free-riders who behave honestly in early rounds and later switch to free-riding, particularly under global-model-mimicking attacks such as the delta weight attack and our newly proposed adaptive WEF-camouflage attack. translated_title: 基于模拟攻击模式的跨筒仓联邦学习中动态搭便车者检测
translated_abstract: 联邦学习（FL）使多个客户端能够通过聚合本地更新来协同训练全局模型，而无需共享私有数据。在这项工作中，我们关注跨筒仓（cross-silo）联邦学习，其中每个客户端通常代表一个独立的组织。然而，跨筒仓联邦学习面临“搭便车者”的挑战——这类客户端不执行实际训练却提交伪造的模型参数，从而在不做任何贡献的情况下获取全局模型。Chen等人提出了一种基于模型参数权重演化频率（WEF）的搭便车者检测方法。这种检测方法非常实用，因为它既不需要代理数据集也不需要预训练。然而，该方法难以检测那些在早期轮次表现诚实、之后转为搭便车行为的“动态”搭便车者，尤其是在增量权重攻击以及我们新提出的自适应WEF伪装攻击等模仿全局模型的攻击下。在本文中，我们……（原文摘要此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出通过模拟攻击模式（包括新提出的自适应WEF伪装攻击）来检测跨筒仓联邦学习中的动态搭便车者，能够识别出前期诚实参与、后期伪造参数以窃取全局模型的恶意客户端。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a method for detecting dynamic free-riders in cross-silo federated learning via simulated attack patterns, including a newly proposed adaptive WEF-camouflage attack, enabling identification of clients that behave honestly in early rounds but later submit fake parameters to obtain the global model without contributing.
